terms.definition: The organ of sight that turns light into signals.
terms.function: Lets light in, focuses it, and senses it.
terms.whereItIs: In the eye sockets of the skull.
terms.whyItMatters: It is how the body senses the visual world.

terms.definition: The clear front window of the eye.
terms.function: Lets light in and starts focusing.
terms.whyItMatters: It is the eye's first light-gathering surface.

terms.definition: The light-sensitive screen at the back of the eye.
terms.whereItIs: Lining the back of the eyeball.
terms.whyItMatters: It is where light becomes a signal.

terms.definition: The flexible part that focuses light on the retina.
terms.function: Bends light so the image is sharp.
terms.whyItMatters: It makes the image clear and in focus.

terms.definition: The nerve carrying sight signals from the eye to the brain.
terms.whereItIs: Leaving the back of the eye toward the brain.
terms.whyItMatters: It is the cable that connects the eye to the brain.
